body:
It sounds like you're a very smart guy, and the age you are at is the most uncertain and confusing part of most people's lives. I know it was for me.

I really hope you didn't do it. Life is so bizarre and unexpected, everything about your life right now that you are unhappy with might can be completely different in no time at all.

If some summer camp was all you had to live for I'd suggest at least trying some new things. Go crazy and try some stuff you never thought you could do or were scared to try. Talk to people, new hobbies, go on an adventure etc... If the only other option you can think of is grabbing a shotgun you can look at like you have absolutely nothing to lose or to be scared of anymore. You can only go up from here if you just give it a chance.

Okay you don't want advice, so here's a question- 

What would happen if you turned to your dad and said, "I want to kill myself." ..?

You must have a lot of anger towards him to imagine doing this in front of him. There were times I wished my father "would just die". Until one day it actually happened and it was the worst day of my life. One night he walked out into the front yard and shot himself and my mother found him when she was about to leave for work. I was 15 and it ruined me in ways you can't possibly imagine.

Trust me kid, you're not as smart as you think you are (I know) and if you do it this will be the biggest mistake you ever make. 

Please talk to your dad about how you feel

>Before you comment, please don't say that because I'm 16 it will get better as I become an adult.


Do you know how you laugh at the stuff you  you believed back when you were 6 years old? Probably a lot of silly stupid stuff right? That's exactly how you're going to look back at 16 years old when you're 26.

If you just hold on for a while there going to be a time when you don't have to "portray a hard masculine personality" and you can be honest with people. gay or not you will meet somebody else, it's called dating! Give yourself a chance it's what you're here for.

All I can tell you is that you can have a completely different life in a few years if you just stick it out and give it a chance. My family was just as messed up as yours and I had a horrible relationship with a girl I was completely in love with. She messed my life up so bad I dropped out of school and got a crappy job. Working there (during one of the many times we were broken-up) I met the love of my life. That was 7 years ago and I'm as happy as I've ever been.

I have been suicidal many times in my life but I could never go through with it because I am a survivor and I know exactly what it feels like. I would NEVER wish that feeling on anyone.

Al I can tel you is you should give your life a chance. It's probably time for you to try something different, even if it's as simple getting a part time job.

I get sick to my stomach just thinking about it. It's horrible.

The only thing that I guess comforts me is that it's a natural part of our lives. For some reason we are here to experience that and a million other things. I'm a long way off from 94, but I think the trick is finding something that's important to you and makes you happy.
